text.en:
1. This Order may be cited as the Medical (Amendment of
Second Schedule) (No. 3) Order 1986.

2. The Second Schedule to the Medical Act 1971 is amended—

(a) by inserting immediately below the institution "Universiti
Kebangsaan Malaysia" and the related qualification
appearing under the country "Malaysia" the following
institution and related qualification:

"Universiti Sains Malaysia Doctor of Medicine"; and

(b) by inserting immediately below the institution "University
of Tasmania" and the related qualification appearing under
the country "Australia" the following institution and
related qualification:

"Flinders University of South Australia Bachelor of
Medicine
and
Bachelor of
Surgery".
Made the 21st May 1986.
[KKM—1 14/22; PN. (PU?) 97/I1I.]
Dato' Mak Hon Kam,
Minister of Health
